name: infra-change-review
description: Review an infrastructure change: what the plan would do, then what has drifted from the declared state.

plan_output.help: Path to a saved `terraform plan` output. Empty asks for one before reviewing.

metadata.when_not_to_use: never to apply a change — this reviews a plan and stops there

config.prompt: Review the plan at {{inputs.plan_output}} (empty = ask for one). Report the create/update/replace/destroy counts first, then every address that would be destroyed or replaced with the attribute that forces it.

Given {{nodes.plan.output}}, report what has drifted from the declared configuration: declared but absent, present but undeclared, and present with differing attributes. Name the attribute for every entry in the third list or leave the entry out.
